# precedence higher

The norm that prevails during this tenure. Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) from [`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md), [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`PrecedenceTenure`](../classes/gmeow-PrecedenceTenure.md) to name the single norm that prevails during the tenure.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one prevailing norm (it is functional) and avoid pointing it at the yielding norm (that is [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md), which must differ by SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) once from the tenure to the prevailing norm, paired with a distinct [`gmeow:precedenceLower`](gmeow-precedenceLower.md) and a [`gmeow:precedenceScope`](gmeow-precedenceScope.md).

### Examples

- ex:pt1 [`gmeow:precedenceHigher`](gmeow-precedenceHigher.md) ex:tier2.
